SAMPLE(1)                   General Commands Manual                   SAMPLE(1)

NAME
     sample – invented tool for the parser tests

SYNOPSIS
     sample [-@ABc] [--color=when]
            [-D format] [file ...]

DESCRIPTION
     This page is made up for the tests. A wrapped description line may start
     with a flag name,
             -I is specified.
     but that line is indented deeper than an option line.

     The following options are available:

     -@      Show invented extra keys.

     -A      Include invented entries.

     -D format
             Use the given invented format.

     --color=when
             Colour output when asked.

     -A      Repeated flag, listed once.

SEE ALSO
     nothing(1)
